title: Project/workspace structure
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has a monorepo split into app, server, core, llm, plugin, and opencode packages with project/workspace identity resolved before session, tool, and permission work.
what_python_has: The Python repo has backend, frontend, Docker infrastructure, and multi-tenant Organization, Project, Workspace, and Session tables with bootstrap tenant creation.
current_behavior: The Python repo has backend, frontend, Docker infrastructure, and multi-tenant Organization, Project, Workspace, and Session tables with bootstrap tenant creation.
missing: No workspace location resolver comparable to OpenCode location middleware
No generated client boundary between backend and frontend packages
polish_needed: Bootstrap tenant still behaves like a default local user
Frontend does not expose organization/project/workspace selection
production_risks: Runs can target the wrong workspace root once multiple workspaces exist.
recommended_next_action: Add project/workspace list/select routes and require selected workspace context on session creation.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_workspaces.py proving session creation uses the requested workspace root and rejects cross-organization IDs.

title: Configuration system
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has layered config discovery, path resolution, agent/plugin/permission config parsing, env integration, and dependency waiting.
what_python_has: Python uses Pydantic Settings with AP_ env prefix, Docker env wiring, and defaults for infrastructure, Ollama, tenant bootstrap, and workspace root.
current_behavior: Python uses Pydantic Settings with AP_ env prefix, Docker env wiring, and defaults for infrastructure, Ollama, tenant bootstrap, and workspace root.
missing: No persisted or file-based agent/tool/permission config
No production validation for default secrets
polish_needed: Development defaults include credentials and broad local assumptions
Settings are cached until restart
production_risks: Permission and model behavior cannot be safely tuned per project without auditable scoped config.
recommended_next_action: Add environment mode validation and a database-backed settings overlay for permission/model defaults.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_config.py proving production mode rejects default secrets and loads workspace-specific permission defaults.

title: Server boot lifecycle
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has server creation with lifecycle hooks, route mounting, UI serving, auth/CORS setup, and CLI serve orchestration.
what_python_has: Python has FastAPI app factory, lifespan logging setup, CORS middleware, explicit router includes, and Typer serve/migrate commands.
current_behavior: Python has FastAPI app factory, lifespan logging setup, CORS middleware, explicit router includes, and Typer serve/migrate commands.
missing: No graceful run cancellation or worker lifecycle
No startup validation that migrations are applied
polish_needed: Lifespan configures logging only
CLI migrate shells out without structured errors
production_risks: Containers can report healthy while runtime dependencies are degraded.
recommended_next_action: Add startup checks for migrations/dependencies and shutdown hooks for background tasks.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_startup.py using TestClient lifespan to prove failed critical dependencies produce explicit degraded state.

title: API route structure
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has typed v2 route groups for sessions, messages, models, providers, permissions, fs, commands, skills, questions, events, and health.
what_python_has: Python has hand-written FastAPI routers for health, models, agents, tools, sessions, messages, permissions, artifacts, system events, and WebSocket.
current_behavior: Python has hand-written FastAPI routers for health, models, agents, tools, sessions, messages, permissions, artifacts, system events, and WebSocket.
polish_needed: Plain dict responses lack shared envelopes
Some detail endpoints do not tenant-filter before returning rows
production_risks: Frontend and future SDK contracts can drift as routes grow.
recommended_next_action: Introduce versioned routers and shared response/error schemas while preserving current aliases.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_api_contract.py validating route envelopes, tenant filtering, and OpenAPI paths.

title: OpenAPI/schema generation
what_opencode_has: OpenCode route schemas are the API contract and feed SDK/client generation with normalized schema errors.
what_python_has: FastAPI publishes OpenAPI automatically, but frontend types are manually maintained in client.ts.
current_behavior: FastAPI publishes OpenAPI automatically, but frontend types are manually maintained in client.ts.
missing: No schema lint check in CI or smoke tests
No shared error schema across every route
polish_needed: Manual frontend types can silently drift
OpenAPI descriptions are sparse
production_risks: A backend change can break the UI without compile-time feedback.
recommended_next_action: Add OpenAPI generation and replace manual wire types with generated or schema-checked types.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add scripts/check-openapi.sh and frontend build validation for generated types.

title: Session model
what_opencode_has: OpenCode sessions include slug, project/workspace, directory/path, parent/forking, model, cost, tokens, share, summaries, revert, permissions, and timestamps.
what_python_has: Python Session has organization/project/workspace/creator, title, agent, model provider/name, status, and metadata_json.
current_behavior: Python Session has organization/project/workspace/creator, title, agent, model provider/name, status, and metadata_json.
polish_needed: Session detail does not tenant-check the requested session
Status values are unconstrained strings
production_risks: Session lineage, accounting, and tenant safety are incomplete.
recommended_next_action: Add session lineage/lifecycle fields, enum constraints, and tenant-scoped detail loading.
test_that_proves_it_works: Extend backend/tests/test_sessions.py to prove tenant-isolated detail and persisted model/cost/status transitions.

title: Message model
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has typed message/part models for text, tool, file, reasoning, error, and assistant step events.
what_python_has: Python stores role/content messages with JSON parts and metadata plus helpers for user, assistant, and tool result messages.
current_behavior: Python stores role/content messages with JSON parts and metadata plus helpers for user, assistant, and tool result messages.
polish_needed: parts is unvalidated JSONB
Tool calls are separate and not rich message parts
production_risks: The UI cannot render precise execution timelines or artifacts without ad hoc metadata parsing.
recommended_next_action: Introduce Pydantic message-part schemas for assistant, tool, permission, and artifact parts.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_messages.py proving typed parts round-trip and invalid payloads are rejected.

title: Agent run model
what_opencode_has: OpenCode processor tracks durable step state, blocked/compaction flags, snapshots, and tool settlement state.
what_python_has: Python AgentRun records agent, model, status, step_count, error, and timestamps for one synchronous run per message.
current_behavior: Python AgentRun records agent, model, status, step_count, error, and timestamps for one synchronous run per message.
polish_needed: Runs execute inside HTTP requests
waiting_permission has no resume entrypoint
production_risks: Long or permission-blocked runs can be lost or require manual re-prompting.
recommended_next_action: Persist run state transitions and add a resume path invoked by approval or worker scheduling.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_agent_run_resume.py proving a waiting_permission run continues after approve.

title: Tool call model
what_opencode_has: OpenCode tool parts track raw streaming input, validated input, output title/metadata/attachments, error status, and settlement.
what_python_has: Python ToolCall stores input_json, input_hash, output_json, status, error, permission_request_id, and timestamps.
current_behavior: Python ToolCall stores input_json, input_hash, output_json, status, error, permission_request_id, and timestamps.
polish_needed: permission_request_id is not a foreign key
waiting_permission rows can remain stuck
production_risks: Audit history can show approval while the original tool never executed.
recommended_next_action: Add FK constraints, normalized status enums, and resume metadata for waiting tool calls.
test_that_proves_it_works: Extend backend/tests/test_tool_call_persistence.py proving permission_request_id references a row and approved calls complete.

title: Event system
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has typed EventV2 definitions, an event bridge, location-scoped subscriptions, and app reducers.
what_python_has: Python has EventType strings, persisted SystemEvent rows, in-process WebSocket broadcast, and a system events route.
current_behavior: Python has EventType strings, persisted SystemEvent rows, in-process WebSocket broadcast, and a system events route.
missing: No Pydantic schema per event type
polish_needed: In-process subscribers do not work across replicas
Payloads are untyped JSON
production_risks: Multi-container deployments will lose live events for sessions handled by another process.
recommended_next_action: Add typed event schemas and Redis-backed pub/sub while keeping SystemEvent as durable store.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_event_bus.py proving event payload validation and replay after reconnect.

title: WebSocket/realtime events
what_opencode_has: OpenCode exposes SSE subscriptions with typed reducers and scoped sync state.
what_python_has: Python exposes a session WebSocket and React opens one for the selected session, refetching detail on every event.
current_behavior: Python exposes a session WebSocket and React opens one for the selected session, refetching detail on every event.
polish_needed: Receive loop ignores client messages
UI refetches full session detail on every event
production_risks: Users can miss permission prompts or tool updates during network blips.
recommended_next_action: Create typed event store with reconnect/replay and backend cursor replay support.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add frontend event reducer test and backend /sessions/{id}/events replay ordering test.

title: Agent registry
what_opencode_has: OpenCode merges built-in agents with config, model/tool permissions, and subagent restrictions.
what_python_has: Python has static build, plan, general, explore, summary, and compaction agents with list/get API.
current_behavior: Python has static build, plan, general, explore, summary, and compaction agents with list/get API.
polish_needed: Prompts are terse and JSON-protocol focused
Allowed tools are fixed at startup
production_risks: Operators cannot tune agents without code changes.
recommended_next_action: Load validated agent overrides from database while retaining safe built-in defaults.
test_that_proves_it_works: Extend backend/tests/test_agent_registry.py proving project-specific override changes model/tools safely.

title: Native agents
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has built-in role prompts, plan/build transitions, summary/compaction internals, and task/subagent permissions.
what_python_has: Python has the requested six native agents with ids, metadata, model config, prompts, tools, permission profile, max steps, and hidden flags.
current_behavior: Python has the requested six native agents with ids, metadata, model config, prompts, tools, permission profile, max steps, and hidden flags.
polish_needed: Prompts are embedded constants
general chat still has editing tools
production_risks: Local chat can request high-authority tools unless permissions catch every path.
recommended_next_action: Move prompts into versioned modules/files and reduce general chat tool authority by default.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_agent_permissions.py proving general/chat cannot mutate files unless configured.

title: Agent prompts/system instructions
what_opencode_has: OpenCode composes default, plan/build, provider-specific, max-step, compaction, and summary prompt assets.
what_python_has: Python concatenates a strict JSON runtime prompt, short role instructions, and compact tool schemas.
current_behavior: Python concatenates a strict JSON runtime prompt, short role instructions, and compact tool schemas.
missing: No max-step or permission reminder injection
No prompt version snapshot on model calls
polish_needed: Local models often ignore strict JSON
Tool schema lacks examples
production_risks: The platform may chat but fail to reliably invoke tools for implementation tasks.
recommended_next_action: Build a prompt/context composer with role prompt, guardrails, tool examples, workspace summary, and compacted history.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_context_builder.py proving prompts contain role, allowed tools, protocol examples, and max-step guardrails.

title: Agent runtime loop
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has a streaming processor with tool settlement, permission blocking, snapshots, compaction, reasoning parts, and LLM events.
what_python_has: Python runs a synchronous bounded loop that calls Ollama, parses JSON final/tool_call, executes tools, and persists messages/runs/model calls.
current_behavior: Python runs a synchronous bounded loop that calls Ollama, parses JSON final/tool_call, executes tools, and persists messages/runs/model calls.
polish_needed: Runs happen inside request/response
Context is unbudgeted transcript
Tool failure ends run instead of allowing correction
production_risks: Production users will see blocked HTTP requests and brittle local model tool behavior.
recommended_next_action: Refactor into a resumable state machine and queue-backed worker while preserving strict JSON for Ollama tool mode.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_agent_runtime_state_machine.py covering final, tool, permission-wait/resume, max-step, and invalid JSON paths.

title: Agent step limits
what_opencode_has: OpenCode combines runtime step decisions with prompt guidance that can stop, continue, or compact.
what_python_has: Python AgentDefinition has max_steps and AgentRunner loops for range(agent.max_steps).
current_behavior: Python AgentDefinition has max_steps and AgentRunner loops for range(agent.max_steps).
polish_needed: Max-step failure is generic
No event emitted for each step
production_risks: Agents can stop abruptly without useful recovery guidance.
recommended_next_action: Emit step events and inject a final-step reminder before the last model call.
test_that_proves_it_works: Extend backend/tests/test_agent_loop.py proving max-step stop persists failure and emits an event.

title: Agent context building
what_opencode_has: OpenCode gathers system context and instructions from project, files, config, tools, prompts, and session state.
what_python_has: Python loads all persisted messages and formats role/content text as transcript.
current_behavior: Python loads all persisted messages and formats role/content text as transcript.
polish_needed: Transcript-only context degrades quickly
Tool results are raw JSON text
production_risks: Long sessions become unreliable and local models lose operational context.
recommended_next_action: Create context builder selecting recent messages, summaries, tool results, workspace metadata, and memory snippets under a budget.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_context_builder.py proving long sessions are windowed and summaries/tool outputs are deterministic.

title: Compaction/summarization
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has summary/compaction services, prompts, compact endpoint behavior, and overflow-triggered compaction.
what_python_has: Python registers hidden summary and compaction agents but no runtime path invokes them.
current_behavior: Python registers hidden summary and compaction agents but no runtime path invokes them.
polish_needed: Hidden agents imply a capability that is unreachable
production_risks: Long sessions eventually fail or become incoherent.
recommended_next_action: Implement summary storage and /sessions/{id}/compact without deleting original messages.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_compaction.py proving compact creates summary metadata and later context uses it.

title: Model provider abstraction
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has provider registry with auth, config, transforms, model discovery/status, and many SDK-backed adapters.
what_python_has: Python has an Ollama provider implementation and router returning only Ollama.
current_behavior: Python has an Ollama provider implementation and router returning only Ollama.
missing: No provider interface enforcement in tests
polish_needed: ModelProvider table is not used by routing
Provider errors mostly pass through httpx
production_risks: Even Ollama-only routing needs capabilities and health state for safe model selection.
recommended_next_action: Formalize provider capabilities and persist provider/model health snapshots.
test_that_proves_it_works: Extend backend/tests/test_ollama_provider.py proving capability metadata and error normalization.

title: Ollama/local model support
what_opencode_has: OpenCode exposes generic provider/model listing and model status through server/provider APIs.
what_python_has: Python lists host Ollama tags, pulls models, generates via /api/generate, and exposes health/models endpoints and a Chat dropdown.
current_behavior: Python lists host Ollama tags, pulls models, generates via /api/generate, and exposes health/models endpoints and a Chat dropdown.
polish_needed: All models are treated as JSON-capable tool users
num_predict default is low for substantive chat
production_risks: Some Ollama tags will chat but fail tool protocol or truncate responses.
recommended_next_action: Add model capability metadata and separate plain chat mode from strict tool JSON mode.
test_that_proves_it_works: Extend backend/tests/test_ollama_provider.py proving list includes host models and generate supports chat/tool modes.

title: Tool registry
what_opencode_has: OpenCode loads built-in, config, plugin, skill, LSP, web, and model/agent-filtered tools.
what_python_has: Python has a static registry of nine native BaseTool implementations with Pydantic schemas and permission keys.
current_behavior: Python has a static registry of nine native BaseTool implementations with Pydantic schemas and permission keys.
missing: No disabled-tool calculation from permission rules
polish_needed: Registry is process-static
OpenCode-to-Python tool mapping is not exposed in API docs
production_risks: Extensibility is blocked until trusted dynamic tool sources are supported.
recommended_next_action: Add reloadable registry providers for plugin/MCP tools while preserving typed Pydantic boundaries.
test_that_proves_it_works: Extend backend/tests/test_tool_registry.py proving duplicate names are rejected and dynamic tools expose schemas safely.

title: Tool metadata/schema validation
what_opencode_has: OpenCode tools expose parameter schemas, JSON schema conversion, metadata, attachments, and typed output.
what_python_has: Python BaseTool exposes model_json_schema for input/output, permission_key, timeout, resource, and async run.
current_behavior: Python BaseTool exposes model_json_schema for input/output, permission_key, timeout, resource, and async run.
polish_needed: Validation failures do not always emit TOOL_CALL_FAILED
Output schema is generic for all tools
production_risks: Local models receive sparse tool guidance and call tools incorrectly.
recommended_next_action: Add schema_version/examples and standardize invalid input feedback.
test_that_proves_it_works: Extend backend/tests/test_tool_registry.py proving every tool has examples, schema_version, and valid JSON schema.

title: File read tool
what_opencode_has: OpenCode read supports file/directory reads, permissions, truncation, and tests.
what_python_has: Python ReadFileTool lists directories, reads UTF-8 line windows, previews binary base64, and uses default allow/read policy.
current_behavior: Python ReadFileTool lists directories, reads UTF-8 line windows, previews binary base64, and uses default allow/read policy.
polish_needed: Binary preview can leak sensitive bytes after approval
Directory listing lacks stat metadata
production_risks: Symlink or secret file paths can expose data unexpectedly.
recommended_next_action: Add secret path detection and symlink escape checks before reading.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_read_tool.py proving symlink escape asks/denies and .env-like files require approval.

title: File write tool
what_opencode_has: OpenCode write is permission-aware and tested around mutation behavior.
what_python_has: Python WriteFileTool writes full content and creates parent directories after ASK permission is created.
current_behavior: Python WriteFileTool writes full content and creates parent directories after ASK permission is created.
polish_needed: Parent directories are created once permission is approved without separate context
No file mode preservation
production_risks: Approved writes can overwrite critical files without diff preview or rollback.
recommended_next_action: Add diff preview metadata, atomic write, symlink/secret checks, and approval resume integration.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_write_tool.py proving ask flow, atomic write, and denied secret overwrite.

title: Edit/patch tool
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has edit/apply_patch tools backed by patch parsing, mutation tests, and output handling.
what_python_has: Python edit does string replacement and patch supports simple Begin/End add/update/delete hunks.
current_behavior: Python edit does string replacement and patch supports simple Begin/End add/update/delete hunks.
polish_needed: Patch update can mishandle context
Edit only supports exact substring replacement
production_risks: Patch application can corrupt files or fail on common diffs.
recommended_next_action: Replace simple parser with a tested patch engine and store before/after diff metadata.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_patch_tool.py with add/update/delete, multi-hunk, context mismatch, and rollback cases.

title: Bash/shell tool
what_opencode_has: OpenCode shell execution is abstracted, permission-integrated, output-truncated, and tested.
what_python_has: Python BashRunTool uses asyncio.create_subprocess_shell with workdir, timeout, combined stdout/stderr, and output truncation.
current_behavior: Python BashRunTool uses asyncio.create_subprocess_shell with workdir, timeout, combined stdout/stderr, and output truncation.
polish_needed: Shell expansion is enabled
External effects depend heavily on manual approval
production_risks: Shell execution is the highest-risk tool and currently too broad.
recommended_next_action: Add shell policy with safe parsing, env scrub, cwd enforcement, and explicit exit-code handling.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_bash_tool.py proving destructive deny, external cwd ask, env scrub, and nonzero exit failure.

title: Grep/search tool
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has ripgrep-backed search with result limits, filesystem utilities, and tests.
what_python_has: Python GrepSearchTool uses rg when present, falls back to Python regex traversal, and truncates to 100 matches.
current_behavior: Python GrepSearchTool uses rg when present, falls back to Python regex traversal, and truncates to 100 matches.
missing: No structured result schema beyond text output
polish_needed: Fallback traversal can be slow
Regex errors are not normalized
production_risks: Large repositories can make search slow or noisy.
recommended_next_action: Normalize regex errors and add include/exclude/gitignore options.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_grep_tool.py proving rg and fallback paths return identical bounded results.

title: Glob tool
what_opencode_has: OpenCode glob is integrated with filesystem utilities and tests for file discovery.
what_python_has: Python GlobSearchTool uses pathlib glob under workspace root and returns up to 100 paths sorted by mtime.
current_behavior: Python GlobSearchTool uses pathlib glob under workspace root and returns up to 100 paths sorted by mtime.
missing: No explicit external path ask test
polish_needed: pathlib semantics may differ from fast-glob expectations
No directory size guard
production_risks: Models can miss files or scan too much in large workspaces.
recommended_next_action: Define glob semantics and ignore behavior matching platform expectations.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_glob_tool.py proving recursive patterns, hidden files, and result truncation.

title: Todo tool
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has todo.write backed by session todo state and tests for persistence/update behavior.
what_python_has: Python TodoWriteTool validates todo items and returns them in tool output metadata.
current_behavior: Python TodoWriteTool validates todo items and returns them in tool output metadata.
missing: No API to read current todos
polish_needed: Tool says update but only returns metadata
Todos disappear from prominent UI after scroll
production_risks: Users cannot trust todo state as a runtime planning artifact.
recommended_next_action: Persist latest todo list per session and expose it in session detail.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_todo_tool.py proving todo.write updates durable session todo state.

title: Question/human input tool
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has a question tool and API flow for asking the user and continuing based on answers.
what_python_has: Python QuestionAskTool validates question prompts and returns metadata saying questions were recorded for UI.
current_behavior: Python QuestionAskTool validates question prompts and returns metadata saying questions were recorded for UI.
polish_needed: Tool output claims UI recording that does not exist
production_risks: Agents that ask clarifying questions cannot receive answers through the runtime.
recommended_next_action: Implement question lifecycle parallel to permission requests with answer resume.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_question_flow.py proving question.ask pauses and resumes with a user answer.

title: Permission engine
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has wildcard rules, ask/reply lifecycle, once/always/reject replies, saved approvals, and deferred execution gating.
what_python_has: Python has default policy, destructive shell denial, external directory ASK, persisted permission_requests, audit rows, and approve/deny endpoints.
current_behavior: Python has default policy, destructive shell denial, external directory ASK, persisted permission_requests, audit rows, and approve/deny endpoints.
missing: No wildcard ruleset used by policy
polish_needed: matcher.py exists but policy uses fixed rules
Resolved permissions do not trigger execution
production_risks: Permission prompts are auditable but operationally incomplete.
recommended_next_action: Add saved approval rules and invoke run resume when a request is approved.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_permission_resume.py proving write.file waits, approve resumes, deny fails, and always approval skips future prompts.

title: Permission request/approval flow
what_opencode_has: OpenCode lists/replies to permission requests by location/session and settles deferred execution with once/always/reject semantics.
what_python_has: Python has GET /permissions plus POST approve/deny endpoints backed by persisted rows and events.
current_behavior: Python has GET /permissions plus POST approve/deny endpoints backed by persisted rows and events.
missing: No strong ownership check on request
polish_needed: Approval returns only permission row
Denied request does not mark linked tool_call failed
production_risks: Users can click Approve and still see the run stuck.
recommended_next_action: Resolve linked tool/run state inside approve/deny and schedule/resume execution.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_permissions_api.py proving approve moves tool_call and agent_run out of waiting_permission.

title: Permission UI integration
what_opencode_has: OpenCode UI has permission context, auto-accept settings, event listener, once/always/reject replies, and CLI prompt footer.
what_python_has: Python UI shows pending permission rows in global Permissions and Chat sidecar with Approve/Deny buttons.
current_behavior: Python UI shows pending permission rows in global Permissions and Chat sidecar with Approve/Deny buttons.
missing: No modal with tool input preview
polish_needed: UI shows key/resource but not full risk context
Chat sidecar can miss global prompts

recommended_next_action: Add permission detail cards/modal with input preview and once/always/deny choices tied to backend resume.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add frontend test proving prompt appears from event and approve updates sidecar/tool status.

title: Doom-loop/repeated action protection
what_opencode_has: OpenCode processor defines DOOM_LOOP_THRESHOLD=3 and can block repeated tool behavior.
what_python_has: Python LoopGuard hashes input_json and blocks same session+agent+tool+input on the third repeated attempt, emitting LOOP_GUARD_BLOCKED.
current_behavior: Python LoopGuard hashes input_json and blocks same session+agent+tool+input on the third repeated attempt, emitting LOOP_GUARD_BLOCKED.
missing: No persisted denied ToolCall row for every loop guard path
No assistant-facing recovery message with alternatives
polish_needed: Only exact JSON matches are blocked
Loop guard exception may skip audit log
production_risks: Repeated harmful variants can still consume resources or mutate state.
recommended_next_action: Persist loop-guard denials and normalize shell/file inputs before hashing.
test_that_proves_it_works: Extend backend/tests/test_loop_guard.py proving third repeat creates denied ToolCall and audit/system event.

title: External directory protection
what_opencode_has: OpenCode has external directory permission behavior and location filesystem tests.
what_python_has: Python policy detects absolute resources outside workspace_root and asks with permission_key external_directory.
current_behavior: Python policy detects absolute resources outside workspace_root and asks with permission_key external_directory.
missing: No symlink escape checks at execution time
No UI warning specific to external paths
polish_needed: Comma-split resource parsing can mis-handle commas in paths
Shell commands are not path-parsed

recommended_next_action: Centralize resolved path authority checks and call it from every file and shell tool.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_external_directory.py proving file, patch, glob, grep, and shell workdirs outside workspace ask or deny consistently.

title: Environment/secret file protection
what_opencode_has: OpenCode handles environment/auth/provider credentials through dedicated layers and policy tests.
what_python_has: Python has no dedicated secret-file policy beyond external directory and destructive shell checks.
current_behavior: Python has no dedicated secret-file policy beyond external directory and destructive shell checks.

No redaction in tool output/model_call request_json
polish_needed: Workspace .env is currently normal read.file because read.file is allowed

recommended_next_action: Implement secret path/content detection and redact sensitive values in tool/model/audit payloads.
test_that_proves_it_works: Add backend/tests/test_secret_policy.py proving .env/private-key reads ask or deny and outputs are redacted.

title: Audit logging
what_opencode_has: OpenCode emits typed events for session/tool/permission lifecycle and persists local runtime state.
what_python_has: Python has AuditLog plus audit rows for tool execute success/failure/denial and permission request/approve/deny.
current_behavior: Python has AuditLog plus audit rows for tool execute success/failure/denial and permission request/approve/deny.
missing: No audit on model calls, session creation, message creation, artifact operations, or loop guard denial
polish_needed: Audit metadata is unredacted JSON
resource_id is not FK-linked
